tools.name: get_symbol_details
tools.description: Get complete documentation for a specific symbol including description, parameters, return type, availability, and other canonical metadata. Use this when you want the authoritative symbol record; for a quicker combined summary that also bundles examples and relationships, use get_symbol_overview. For detailed exploration of relationships (protocols, inheritance, usage), use get_related_symbols. For resolving multiple symbols at once, use get_symbols_batch instead.

tools.name: browse_module

module.description: Module name. Required for module browsing and also used to scope text-based symbol search when query is provided.

query.description: Optional: text search query (e.g. 'Button', 'VStack alignment', 'List selection'). When provided, this tool returns symbol search results scoped to the selected module instead of a plain module listing.

limit.description: Maximum number of results (default: 50 for browsing, also used for query-based search)

tools.description: List symbols in a module or category, or perform text-based symbol discovery within a module. Useful for discovering available APIs before drilling into details, examples, relationships, or using the combined get_symbol_overview workflow. When query is provided, this tool also performs the former symbol search behavior and returns matching symbols using fuzzy name/description search.

tools.name: get_symbols_batch
tools.description: Get complete documentation for multiple symbols in a single call. Use this for bulk retrieval when you already know several paths; for a single-symbol combined summary, use get_symbol_overview.
